text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Oh my gosh, it's here! This year's Arima is incredible! All three big stars are running!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text: Welcome to this year's Arima Kinen! Who'll reign supreme in this contest of dreams?!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text: First up, we have the uncrowned champion of the Classic year! As a regional racer, she didn't run in the Triple Crown, but her power is undeniable!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: For myself and everyone back at home… I can't lose.

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text: Next, we have the undisputed champion of the senior year. The small, white giant with oh-so-many G1 victories.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Aw, yeah! Time to show everybody what this Osaka girl can do! I'll take 'em all out!

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text: And finally, we have our late-blooming superstar who's come so far with her greenhorn trainer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Come on, Trainer! Hop on up here with me. Don't be shy now!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: You're not takin' this seriously! Okay, thassit. We're done. Shut it down, everybody!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe! People were kind of laughing at us, huh?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: But this race is the final chapter of a difficult year. This isn't the time or place for regrets.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Thanks. Even Tamtam was concerned for me regarding my journey here.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'll make sure to repay the favor by running the best race I can! ♪
